Bull Case/PT
Core Azure growth accelerates further, and MSFT’s GenAI contribution becomes stronger
and more diversified via faster adoption of Microsoft 365 Copilot, GitHub Copilot, and
Security Copilot. Impressive operating margin expansion persists even as the company
invests in key growth areas (GenAI, Fabric, etc. ). Our bull case valuation utilizes a
CY26-27E P/E multiple of 40x and 33x, equating to $700. Bear Case/PT
Core Azure growth decelerates more than expected due to increasing competition, an
execution misstep and/or a worsening macro environment. Adoption of GenAI offerings
shows signs of plateauing after the initial adoption wave. Operating margins are lower
than expected, as MSFT cannot remotely offset investments that increasingly impact the
model. Our bear case valuation utilizes a CY26-27E P/E multiple of 24x and 20x, equating
to $420. Risks
Core consumption growth decelerates more than anticipated as macro challenges
resurface. Competition among cloud infrastructure providers materially increases, leading
to pricing pressure. GenAI adoption and monetization is slower than expected. Azure
suffers a significant breach, triggering churn and a loss of customer confidence. MSFT
fails to anticipate and adapt to evolving technology trends. Global PC shipments slow and
the “AI PC” era does not in fact help MSFT. Ongoing success and dominance across a
range of enterprise markets globally prompts increased regulatory scrutiny.

capturing greater value has been the more important driver of growth. In this respect, we like
the introduction of E7 today as it enables the continuation of MSFT's upsell strategy by bundling
more value into an offering at a higher price point. E7 should increase investors' confidence that
MSFT can maintain solid Office growth (currently around mid-teens level YoY) for longer.

We also
note the launch of Wave 3 for MSFT Copilot which includes the offering of Anthropic's models
(beside OpenAI) and Claude Cowork capabilities and cements MSFT's role as a successful fast
follower of new technology. When MSFT launched Copilot a while ago, many investors asked why it was not part of a new
SKU (E7 for example). At the time, it seemed MSFT wanted to make Copilot available to a
broader audience (not just the high-end SKU customers) and hence the separate pricing. However, it does create friction in the sales process, especially for the enterprise level, if two
different pricing agreements (an Office SKU and the Copilot commitment) and discount levels
need to be discussed. In this respect, the new E7 offerings is just a natural extension. E7 includes
E5 plus Copilot and Agent 365. At $99 per user, the offering is above the $60 E5 price (price
update on July 2026) but is cheaper than the individual components (E5 $60 plus Copilot $30
plus Agent 365 $15). We note that in recent quarters, E5 was mentioned as the main growth
driver for Office growth, followed by Copilot. With its product announcements today, Microsoft also provides an answer for another recent
investor discussion point around the evolution of work.

text:
Security 对 agentic adoption 及 E7 bundle 咁關鍵，因為 Security Copilot agent 已被證明能大幅提升安全團隊的效率。例如，Icertis 的 SOC 團隊使用 Security Copilot agent 降低手動 triage 時間 75%，在面對嚴重人才短缺的行業中，這是一個真正的轉折點【KB:14】。同時，安全領域的 agent 需要整合 Entra、Defender、Purview 和 Intune 等 Microsoft 安全產品，形成端到端的保護架構，這不僅強化了安全操作的自動化與即時性，也為企業提供更穩健的基礎來部署和管理 AI 應用【KB:5,14】。此外，安全領域的 agent 需要強大的身份驗證、風險信號和可觀察性（observability），這些功能正是 E7 SKU 所包含的 Agent 365 的核心功能，使 E7 成為一個整合安全、協作與 AI 的「前端」（frontier）套件，進而推動企業採用 E7 作為升級方案，實現更全面的 AI 數位轉型【KB:13,14】。
